$comment: Copy this file to the ROOT of each project you work in and rename it to 'sovai.config.json', then edit the three lists to match that project's actual layout. SoVai's hooks walk up from an edited file to the nearest sovai.config.json to decide what the file is; a project with no config is NOT gated at all. Only this project knows which of its directories are UI, and ADR-0007 makes that distinction load-bearing, which is why there is no plugin-side default to fall back on. Keys: 'productionLogic' = paths where TDD is mandatory (a first edit there points at the `tdd` skill, and ending the session without invoking it is blocked); 'ui' = the deliberate TDD exception, tested after implementation via `ui-testing`; 'tests' = test files, gated by nothing. Precedence is tests, then ui, then productionLogic — so UI paths nested under a production path win, and you never write exclusions into productionLogic. Patterns are shell globs matched against the path relative to this file's directory, where '*' also crosses '/': 'src/**' matches 'src/a/b.ts', and '*.test.*' matches a test file at any depth. Prefer that forgiving form over '**/*.test.*', which requires at least one directory and so misses a test file at the project root.
